title: Newton's second law of motion (নিউটনের দ্বিতীয় গতি সূত্র)
placement: Book pages 75–76, topic 3.6: বস্তুর গতির উপর বলের প্রভাব: নিউটনের দ্বিতীয় গতি সূত্র. Next to the football and cricket-ball examples, the law in its box and the steps to F = ma.
description: Newton's second law (নিউটনের দ্বিতীয় সূত্র, pages 75–76, 3.6) with the book's own example, a handcart (ঠেলাগাড়ি) pushed from rest, on a smooth floor (friction left out, said on the view). One tap and a person pushes the wooden cart for 2 s with 100 N: an orange F arrow at the crossbar, a teal acceleration arrow over the cart and a blue velocity arrow that grows by the same amount every second (a mark on the floor every second); then he lets go and the cart rolls on at the velocity it has until a pile of rice sacks at the end of the floor stops it. The panel is one action, one result, one rule: a row of four examples (খালি গাড়ি, দ্বিগুণ বল with two people, দ্বিগুণ ভর with two 50 kg sacks, উল্টো দিকে বল where a second person pushes back on the moving cart), a big numbered button whose same badge rings the cart, the result line working out a = (v − u) ÷ t (1, 2, 0.5 and −1 ms⁻², written under each word), and a rule that grows from F = ma (k = 1) through 'double the force, double the acceleration' and 'double the mass, half the acceleration' to 'the momentum changes in the direction of the force' (200 to 0 kg m/s) and the book's law word for word. Real numbers, real time. Test tab: 5 questions on scenes set up for them (the acceleration from the force and the masses read off the picture, the acceleration when the force or the mass is doubled after a run, the direction of the change of momentum when the force is against the motion, two carts side by side compared, and the law in the book's words).
